entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Hey.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sorry... It's nothing.
C'mon, what's up?
Doesn't seem like nothing.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I was just... remembering what[n]happened that night.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You remember, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The night before we went into Mementos[n]to erase it... Before we'd dealt with[n]Shido...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Remember how I said I'd finally[n]found the place where I belong?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even though I said that—and really[n]believed it—I still fell right into[n]Maruki's hands.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I know I've made it obvious how much[n]I want to be a human...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: More than once, I thought it would[n]give me a chance with Lady Ann, but...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What I did was just so lame.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I can't believe I was off having a blast[n]while you were busy trying to help us.
I understand why though.
But you came back.
You owe me one.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Quit being so nice to me!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you try excusing something this big,[n]I'd be more disappointed than anything.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, yeah, that's true, but I mean...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That was just the right thing to do.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I don't think a single favor's going to[n]make up for what I did.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I already owe you a whole lot more[n]than that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now that I think about it, you've been[n]helping me from the very beginning.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hell, I was locked up in a prison when[n]we first met. *sigh* I'm nowhere near[n]cool...
You don't have to be cool.
You're already super cool.
Nowhere near it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, that's true.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And after all we've been through[n]together, there's no point trying to[n]act cool in front of you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Quit buttering me up!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't have to tell me twice, though—[n]I'm going to be super cool from here[n]on out!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, I just said that!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I didn't need to hear it parroted back[n]at me!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Know what? I'm going to make you[n]a promise right now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: From here on, I'm going to be more[n]independent!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I just kept relying on you for everything[n]because, deep down... I thought you[n]could figure everything out for me...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But that's all changing!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm going to stand proud on my own[n]four feet...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And I'm going to be the one to protect[n]you. I promise I will!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've discovered a new... no, my original[n]power!
Morgana's Persona [clr 1]Mercurius[clr 27] has[n]transformed into [clr 2]Diego[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, time to serve Maruki his[n]just desserts!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyone who tries to pull one over[n]on us like that is asking for it!
Let's do our best.
But you wished for it...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Right! Sorry again for all the hassle.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You and I are gonna be even greater[n]partners now!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hrgh! I mean, it's true, but... let's just[n]forget that part!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's reject Maruki's world together[n]and fight for our REAL reality!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're gonna be even greater partners[n]now!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well... things are going to get hectic[n]starting tomorrow. Let's call it a night!
